list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Refactor: migrate project to monorepo structure
- Moved existing Kotlin Android application into a dedicated `mobile` directory to serve as the frontend. - Created a new `backend` directory and initialized a Node.js project. - Installed Express and set up a basic server entry point (`index.js`). - Added a `start` script to the backend `package.json`. - Separated frontend and backend contexts to support a unified monorepo repository.

task.summary:
Refactor Landlord Dashboard UI and implement modern Pie Chart
• Redesigned Revenue Overview: Replaced the legacy bar graph with a modern, static Pie Chart built natively using Jetpack Compose Canvas. The new chart features smooth arc strokes, dynamic theming colors, and a clean legend for a more premium look. • Streamlined Dashboard Navigation: Removed the inline vertical list from the main dashboard to reduce visual clutter. Reorganized the core navigation sections into a clean 2x2 grid of action button tabs ( Properties , Maintenance , Tenants , Finances ). • Updated Property Management Screen: Updated LandlordDashboardViewModel to pipe property data into the UI state. The PropertyManagementScreen now correctly iterates over this state to render static properties using the PropertyCard component, replacing the previous blank placeholder items.
feat: implement auth screens and UI mock integration
